messages.text:
"Create a realistic cinematic jungle sniper stealth game in a dense tropical rainforest. The player is an elite sniper infiltrating enemy territory, moving silently through thick vegetation while avoiding enemy patrols.
Environment: Extremely detailed jungle with massive trees, rocks, tall grass, bushes, muddy trails, rivers, fog and dynamic sunlight. Use trees, rocks and tall grass as realistic hiding places. Enemies patrol dynamically and react to suspicious movements and sounds.
Gameplay: Tactical first-person perspective. Crouch, crawl, move slowly, hide behind natural cover, observe enemy positions and eliminate selected targets with a sniper rifle. Avoid detection and carefully plan every movement.
Sniper Mechanics: Realistic sniper scope with subtle breathing movement, delicate hand tremors, slight weapon sway, heartbeat effects and realistic aiming instability. The crosshair moves naturally with breathing and body position. Prone positioning provides greater stability. Realistic bullet trajectory, distance compensation and wind effects.
Atmosphere: Intense psychological tension, immersive jungle ambience, distant enemy voices, insects, birds, rustling leaves and approaching footsteps. Slow-paced stealth gameplay with sudden moments of danger.
Graphics: Photorealistic 3D graphics, realistic vegetation physics, cinematic lighting, detailed weapon animations and immersive spatial audio.
Make the player feel physically present in a dangerous jungle, constantly hiding, observing and waiting for the perfect moment to take a shot.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
